::enum::CubeLUTInterpolation::enum class: Interpolation algorithm used for 3D cube lookup.

CubeLUT3D::static method::dataBytes::sta: Data payload size in bytes (excludes the 4-byte file header).
CubeLUT3D::static method::fileBytes::sta: Total file size including the 4-byte header.
CubeLUT3D::static method::maxGridForByte: Largest grid size whose data fits within `availableBytes`.
CubeLUT3D::static method::parseHeader::s: Parse the 4-byte file header.  Returns true if the header describes a valid cube (grid >= 2, channels in 3..CUBE_MAX_SUPPORTED_CHANNELS).
CubeLUT3D::method::attach::void attach(u: Attach a pre-populated, caller-owned data buffer. The buffer must contain gridSize³ × channels uint16 values.
CubeLUT3D::method::setLogicalToStoredMap: Configure logical-to-stored channel mapping. `count` must equal current `channels` and describe a permutation over [0..channels-1].
CubeLUT3D::method::loadFromFileBuffer::b: Load from a complete file buffer (4-byte header followed by payload). The `data` pointer must already point to a buffer of at least dataBytes(grid, ch) bytes — call parseHeader() first to discover the size, allocate, then call this. Returns false on header mismatch or insufficient buffer size.
CubeLUT3D::method::lookup::RgbwTargets l: Interpolated lookup (trilinear or tetrahedral).  Maps input RGB (Q16) through the cube and returns logical RGBW output. For RGBW cubes all four channels are populated. For RGB cubes, wQ16 is always 0.
CubeLUT3D::method::lookupRgbww::RgbwwTar: Logical RGBWW/RGBCCT output. For cubes with <5 channels, missing channels are returned as 0.
CubeLUT3D::method::lookupChannels::uint8: Raw logical channel lookup. Returns number of channels written (up to outCapacity), or 0 on invalid cube.
CubeLUT3D::method::setDefaultInterpolati: Apply default interpolation policy by channel family: - RGB (3ch): Trilinear - RGBW/RGBCCT/future 5-6ch: Tetrahedral
CubeLUT3D::method::isValid::bool isValid: Return true when data, grid size, and channel count describe a usable cube.
CubeLUT3D::method::isRGB::bool isRGB() c: Return true when the attached cube has RGB output.
CubeLUT3D::method::isRGBW::bool isRGBW(): Return true when the attached cube has RGBW output.
CubeLUT3D::method::isRGBWW::bool isRGBWW: Return true when the attached cube has RGBWW/RGBCCT-style output.
CubeLUT3D::field::data::uint16_t* data: Caller-owned cube payload: gridSize^3 * channels uint16 values.
CubeLUT3D::field::gridSize::uint16_t gri: Cube dimension per axis; valid cubes require gridSize >= 2.
CubeLUT3D::field::channels::uint8_t chan: Stored output channel count; valid cubes support 3..CUBE_MAX_SUPPORTED_CHANNELS.
::enum::WhitePolicy::enum class WhitePol: Strategy for deciding when extracted white output is allowed.
::enum::PixelLayout::enum class PixelLay: Logical pixel layout used to derive channel count for LUT and render paths.
::enum::FifthChannelSolveMode::enum clas: Controls whether logical W2 uses the W ladder or a native fifth-channel ladder.

::enum::LedColorOrder::enum class LedCol: Physical byte-order presets for mapping logical solver channels to LED buffers.
::enum::BfiMapStorageMode::enum class Bf: Storage layout for BFI maps passed to consolidated render/commit APIs.
::enum::PhaseMode::enum class PhaseMode: Phase distribution mode for BFI rendering.
::using::SolverFn::using SolverFn = Enco: Solver callback that maps a Q16 value and logical channel to an EncodedState.
::using::CalibrationFn::using Calibratio: Calibration callback that maps an input Q16 value and logical channel to calibrated Q16.
::struct::LadderEntry::struct LadderEntr: Measured ladder sample used by the policy solver for one output state.
::struct::CalibrationMixingConfig::struc: Weighting and threshold knobs used by measured RGBW calibration profiles.

::struct::RenderOptions::struct RenderOp: Render/commit options for logical channel layout, physical byte order, and BFI map storage.

::struct::RgbwTargets::struct RgbwTarget: Four-channel RGBW target values in Q16.

SolverRuntime::method::setTransferCurveM: Select shared or per-channel transfer-curve lookup mode.

SolverRuntime::method::setFifthChannelSo: Select whether logical W2 solves through W emulation or a native fifth-channel ladder.
SolverRuntime::method::fifthChannelSolve: Return the active fifth-channel solve mode.
SolverRuntime::method::setLedColorOrder:: Configure physical byte-order mapping for rendered buffers; solver/commit order remains logical GRB(W/W1W2).
SolverRuntime::method::ledColorOrder::Le: Return the active physical byte-order mapping.
SolverRuntime::static method::channelCou: Derive channel count from a color-order contract: RGB=3, RGBW=4, RGBWW/RGBCCT=5.
SolverRuntime::method::activeRenderChann: Return the current render channel count derived from ledColorOrder().
SolverRuntime::method::setCustomColorOrd: Set a custom 3-channel logical-to-physical map; entries must be a permutation of [0..2].
Set a custom 4-channel logical-to-physical map; entries must be a permutation of [0..3].
Set a custom 5-channel logical-to-physical map; entries must be a permutation of [0..4].
SolverRuntime::method::setCalibrationFun: Register a per-channel input calibration callback used before solving.
SolverRuntime::method::setCalibrationEna: Enable or disable input calibration callback application.
SolverRuntime::method::calibrationEnable: Return whether input calibration is enabled.
SolverRuntime::method::applyCalibration:: Apply the active input calibration callback to one Q16 value and channel.
SolverRuntime::method::setWhiteLimit::vo: Set the maximum 8-bit white-channel value allowed by applyWhiteLimit().
SolverRuntime::method::extractRgbw::Rgbw: Extract RGBW targets from RGB input using the configured calibration and white policy.
SolverRuntime::method::applyWhiteLimit::: Clamp white output and redistribute excess into RGB channels where possible.
SolverRuntime::method::extractRgbwwEmula: Split extracted white equally into W1/W2 for RGBWW/RGBCCT bringup emulation.
SolverRuntime::method::solveWhiteEmulate: Solve a white target through the existing W solver/LUT path for RGBWW/RGBCCT emulation.
SolverRuntime::method::setCubeLUT3D::voi: Attach a non-owning 3D cube LUT pointer for RGB-to-output color correction.
SolverRuntime::method::setCubeLUT3DEnabl: Enable or disable cube LUT lookup in the input pipeline.
SolverRuntime::method::cubeLUT3DEnabled:: Return whether cube LUT lookup is enabled.
SolverRuntime::method::applyCubeLUT3D::R: Look up (rQ16, gQ16, bQ16) through the attached 3D cube. Legacy RGBW-compatible view: for 5-channel cubes this returns W1. If the cube is disabled or missing, returns passthrough RGB + W=0.
SolverRuntime::method::applyCubeLUT3D_RG: RGBWW/RGBCCT-capable cube lookup. For RGB cubes: W1=W2=0. For RGBW cubes: W2=0. If the cube is disabled or missing, returns passthrough RGB + W1/W2=0.
SolverRuntime::method::setPhaseMode::voi: Set the BFI phase distribution mode used by instance render APIs.
SolverRuntime::method::phaseMode::PhaseM: Return the active BFI phase distribution mode.
SolverRuntime::method::setCycleLength::v: Set the global cycle length used by DistributedGlobal mode, clamped to the supported range.
SolverRuntime::method::cycleLength::uint: Return the active global cycle length.
SolverRuntime::method::advanceTick::bool: Advance the internal tick counter. Returns true when the tick reaches a cycle boundary (start of a new display cycle).
SolverRuntime::method::resetTick::void r: Reset the internal render tick to 0.
SolverRuntime::method::currentTick::uint: Return the current internal render tick.
SolverRuntime::method::channelActiveOnCu: Check whether a channel with the given BFI level shows its upper value on the current internal tick, using the configured mode.
SolverRuntime::static method::renderLoop: Render a full buffer using an explicit FixedMask phase and RenderOptions.
SolverRuntime::static method::renderInde: Render one pixel using an explicit FixedMask phase and RenderOptions.
SolverRuntime::method::renderLoop::void: Render a full buffer using the configured PhaseMode and current internal tick.
SolverRuntime::method::renderIndexed::vo: Render one pixel using the configured PhaseMode and current internal tick.
SolverRuntime::static method::commitPixe: Commit one pixel's encoded channel states to logical frame buffers and BFI maps.
SolverRuntime::method::dumpLUTHeader::vo: Emit the currently attached LUTs as an embeddable PROGMEM header.
